issues.description: The render draws filled dots at the endpoints M and N and at the top point P. The original shows no visible dot at these three points, only at A, B and O. The labels themselves are correctly placed.
issues.suggestion: Remove the dot marker on M, N and P (keep the labels), so that only O, A and B are drawn as dots, matching the original.
